caveats: Ranked on DAILY totals. A short violent burst on an otherwise modest day can be under-ranked; intensity, not daily depth, is what floods a wadi. Mitigated by a generous top-N and by forcing in the literature dates — not eliminated. Belongs in the model card.
Percentiles are per catchment. AQ-C01 reaches the Ma'an highlands and AQ-C05 is a coastal wadi; a shared threshold would describe neither.
